title: AIFC Historical Key Lifecycle Ledger v1
description: Content-addressed local lifecycle ledger. event_hashes are replayed in order from the deterministic key-lifecycle genesis sentinel and final_head_hash must equal the final event hash (or the genesis sentinel for an empty ledger). cutoff_registry_hash identifies the registry snapshot through which the producer claims this local lifecycle view was assembled. This object deliberately states that external completeness/freshness is NOT proven; a later external freshness/transparency gate must bind the accepted lifecycle head.
